products.name: HIPAA & HITRUST Endpoint Compliance & Vulnerability Remediation (Intune + Defender) — Commercial
products.short_description: Turn HIPAA and HITRUST expectations into enforced reality on clinical endpoints — map the controls to Microsoft Intune compliance + configuration baselines, gate access with Conditional Access, remediate exposure with Defender for Endpoint vulnerability management, and capture audit-ready evidence. Self-guided, tested.
products.description:
Map the controls, enforce them on every endpoint, and prove it

"We're HIPAA compliant" means little without enforced controls and evidence on the endpoints that touch ePHI. This solution maps HIPAA Security Rule safeguards and HITRUST CSF control expectations to concrete Microsoft Intune compliance policies + configuration baselines (encryption/BitLocker, screen-lock/timeout, AV/Defender, firewall, patch currency, access controls), gates access with Conditional Access so non-compliant devices can't reach ePHI, drives Defender for Endpoint vulnerability remediation, and produces audit-ready evidence and reporting. (This delivers technical enforcement + evidence — not a legal compliance certification.)

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the control-mapping → enforce → gate → remediate → evidence model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune licensing, Defender for Endpoint / Vulnerability Management licensing + onboarding, Entra ID P1 for Conditional Access, BitLocker-capable devices, the clinical endpoint group, a control mapping/owner, an evidence store) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing, plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Implementation Guide — map controls, build named compliance policies + config baselines, gate with Conditional Access, run the Defender vulnerability-remediation workflow, and capture evidence/reporting — full nav paths, named objects.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — readiness discovery, per-device validation (compliant + BitLocker + Defender + key settings), compliance + TVM exposure + evidence report, safe remediation, and a compliance-baseline + CA-gate scaffolder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates (devices Compliant, CA blocks non-compliant, safeguards enforced, exposure reduced, evidence produced), plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Clinical endpoints with HIPAA/HITRUST-aligned safeguards enforced by Intune, non-compliant access blocked by Conditional Access, vulnerabilities remediated via Defender, and audit-ready evidence on hand.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • HIPAACOMP-Discovery.ps1 — HIPAACOMP-Discovery — Tenant readiness check for HIPAA & HITRUST endpoint
    • HIPAACOMP-Remediation.ps1 — HIPAACOMP-Remediation — Safe, targeted remediation for a named clinical
    • HIPAACOMP-Report.ps1 — HIPAACOMP-Report — Audit-ready compliance + vulnerability exposure evidence
    • HIPAACOMP-Set-ComplianceBaseline.ps1 — HIPAACOMP-Set-ComplianceBaseline — Scaffold the HIPAA/HITRUST compliance policy
    • HIPAACOMP-Validation.ps1 — HIPAACOMP-Validation — Per-device validation of HIPAA/HITRUST endpoint

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
